2.2.title: Hypothesis Development
2.2.purpose: Convert the 2.1 framework into formal, falsifiable, empirically-grounded predictions about WHERE/WHEN the signal appears -- never WHY. Each hypothesis states a prediction (direction + where/when), the mechanism-to-prediction logic, and the prior empirical finding that makes it non-obvious.
2.2.serves: Falsifiable claims with stakes; the bridge to the designs (2.4 maps each design to a hypothesis).
2.2.boundary: Predictions only; do NOT define the measure (2.3) or estimator (2.4); never assert a cause.
2.2.thin_claim: H1a = concentration, not strict specificity; no hypothesis asserts a cause; the scrutiny alternative is a real competing hypothesis, not a strawman.

subsection_prop_chain.claim: The 2.1 framework's two dimensions (anticipatory x cash-concentrated) yield testable predictions about where/when the language signal appears, not why.
subsection_prop_chain.grounding: roadmap 2.2 Must-do 1

subsection_prop_chain.claim: H1 (anticipatory run-up): residual Q&A uncertainty is elevated in the pre-announcement quarter of cash acquirers, relative to their own other quarters.
subsection_prop_chain.grounding: roadmap 2.2 Must-do 2; claim C2 (cash 0.0461***, survives two-tailed p=.0074). Contrast vs thewissen2024 managed tone before stock deals -> we predict the opposite register: unmanaged uncertainty before cash deals.

subsection_prop_chain.claim: H1a (cash-concentration): the run-up is stronger for cash than for stock acquirers -- framed as concentration, not strict specificity.
subsection_prop_chain.grounding: roadmap 2.2 Must-do 3; claim C6 (EFFECT_diff 0.0983**, z=2.06, p=.039, valid at 5% two-tailed; stock arm imprecise -> supportive not definitive). Ground vs Harford cash-acquisitiveness.

subsection_prop_chain.claim: H1b (differential timing): uncertainty resolves at announcement (information clock); the acquirer's cash persists to completion (transaction clock).
subsection_prop_chain.grounding: roadmap 2.2 Must-do 4; claim C1 (strongest: PRE1 0.0473***, POST -0.0250*, PRE1-POST 0.0723***; cash GAP persists, POST -0.0155***). Distinguish from price run-up/leakage (Keown-Pinkerton): we track LANGUAGE, not price.

subsection_prop_chain.claim: The competing analyst-scrutiny reading (analysts ask harder cash questions) is a real alternative hypothesis -- stated formally here as the prediction 4.1 tests and rules out.
subsection_prop_chain.grounding: roadmap 2.2 Must-do 5; claim C4 (scrutiny rule-out: gating interaction -0.0056 n.s.). Gives the 4.1 rule-out a home; frame as competing hypothesis not strawman.

2.5.title: Specification and Measurement of Key Constructs
2.5.purpose: Validate the construct (convergent + discriminant) and pre-empt the scrutiny confound -- earn trust the residual measures what's claimed BEFORE results.
2.5.serves: Construct credibility; pre-registers the 4.1 scrutiny rule-out; defines remaining key constructs.
2.5.boundary: Validity + scrutiny construct + key non-main constructs. MAIN var -> 2.3. Scrutiny RESULTS -> 4.1. Controls -> Appendix.
2.5.thin_claim: Convergent = 'consistent with' (weak, disclosed); discriminant = decisive; scrutiny = 'doesn't account for THIS run-up,' not 'never matters.'
